Gideon corrected the number to **280 seats** for Vantorre Group. In the July 1 thread in #strategic-pod he first posted 300. A few minutes later he retracted it. He said he had been reading a staging tab that included sandbox logins from the May rollout. The production roster as of July 1 shows 280 active seats.

In that thread you also asked him to put the corrected roster in the Q3 QBR deck. He said he was updating the slides and the CRM fields. The 280 figure is from July 1, so it's worth checking it's still current before the deck goes out.
